Open product question: should the fallback also fire when every requested channel settled DEAD (unreachable) rather than SUPPRESSED (refused)? That is arguably the more valuable trigger - it is the 'no verified address' case from the proposal's Why - but the specs say SUPPRESSED, so the narrower behaviour ships and is pinned by a test either way.

Real-time push is absent by design (a stated non-goal) and carries no rule, deliberately, because a rule with no code to fire on passes forever and reads as coverage. The obligation belongs to the change that introduces push.
README.ru.md has no 'Build and test' section, so the updated test counts appear only in the English README. Pre-existing drift, not introduced here.

The inbox unread count is uncached and read straight from Postgres on every poll. Correct before fast, and deliberate - a cache would need a CachePurpose nobody can yet justify - but it is the first thing to measure if a client polls it aggressively.
